{{Quote|The chrysalis is a ritual of the Dawn Herald. It makes us stronger, better able to face the enemies of the nest, and embrace our link to the universe.|Vector Hyllus|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Chrysalis of Tranquility''' was a ritual performed by [[Dawn Herald]] [[Joiner]]s of the [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] hives. [[Vector Hyllus]] of [[Oroboro]] performed such ritual during his travels with [[Cipher Nine]].
